as a going concern, so that it can continue to provide returns for shareholders and benefits for oth
stakeholders and to maintain an optimal capital structure to reduce the cost of capital. In order to maintain
or adjust the capital structure, the Company may adjust the amount of dividends paid to shareholders,
issue new shares or obtain / repay long term financing from / to financial institutions.
Consistent with others in the industry, the Company manages its capital risk by monitoring its debt levels
and liquid assets, keeping in view future investment requirements and expectations of the shareholders.
